terms.comment: Scheller’s phrase, in Morgan–Owens: it names the cabbage, and acidus is Pliny’s word for sour milk and sour cheese (Lewis & Short).

evidence: M-O s.v. cabbage: sauerkraut (Plin. NH 26.88; André)
terms.comment: Pliny’s phrase, which Morgan–Owens, following André, takes to be sauerkraut. We have not read the passage in Pliny, so the identification rests on Morgan–Owens.

sources: Catō Agr. 156, 1 and 7, 4, checked against the project’s Catō loci table.
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. cabbage: sauerkraut.
Lewis & Short: holus · Lewis & Short: acidus · Lewis & Short: brassica
